root_text:
HMPV ALERT: Human metapneumovirus cases are surging globally. 

India reports 7 cases, China sees a spike, but WHO says it's seasonal, not a pandemic. 

Take precautions this winter! #HMPVOutbreak #GlobalHealthAlert https://t.co/qsQ7fomLWM
